note: 13D/A n° 17 du 2025-06-20 : cession en bloc par Project 9 LLC de 21 500 000 actions T-Mobile à un courtier non affilié (règle 144), produit net d'environ 4,8 Md$. Vente secondaire : aucune arête
quote: On June 17, 2025, Project 9 LLC sold an aggregate of 21,500,000 shares of Common Stock in an unregistered block sale transaction with an unaffiliated broker dealer pursuant to Rule 144 under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, for net proceeds of approximately $4.8 billion
